messages.author: bd20e150e28c63db
messages.subject: Error in edmr
parts:
Hello,

First I want to thank for the great tools methylkit and edmr. I am getting an error with the edmr command and will be grateful if you could possibly help.

I am working on rrbs data (2 replicates but unfortunately it is very low coverage: samples ranging from 1.7M - 6M reads)).

I  ran methylkit in the following way:
myobj=read(file.list_samples2_5,
           sample.id=list("sample2a","sample2b","sample5a","sample5b"),
           assembly="hg19",
           treatment=c(0,0,1,1),
           context="CpG"
)
filtered.myobj = filterByCoverage(myobj,lo.count=4)
meth.filtered=methylKit::unite(filtered.myobj,destrand=TRUE)

#find diff methylation - single base resolution
myDiff_single_base=calculateDiffMeth(meth)
myDiff_single_base_filtered=calculateDiffMeth(meth.filtered)  #has only 3673 observations

I then wanted to continue with edmr.

myMixmdl=myDiff.to.mixmdl(myDiff_single_base_filtered, plot=T, main="sample 5 vs 2 filtered min cov 4")

Now for the edmr command I am getting the following error:
mydmr=edmr(myDiff_single_base_filtered, mode=1, ACF=TRUE)
[1] "DMR analysis for all detected CpGs..."
number of iterations= 11 
[1] 1723.695
[1] "raw myDiff:"
[1] 3673    7
[1] "max cpgs dist for region definition: 1724"
[1] "auto correlation calculation. step: 100 dist: -Inf"
Error in 1:dist : result would be too long a vector
In addition: Warning message:
In max(dt.pk.myD[refine.pk.idx, as.integer(rend) - as.integer(rstart)]) :
  no non-missing arguments to max; returning -Inf


Thanks a lot
